justification.modalDescription: Document the professional rationale for benchmark selection, OM %, and Haircut % (PM) in compliance with ISA 320 and SK-5/2024 standards.
justification.factor1Desc: Rationale for selecting the benchmark account (PBT, Assets, or Revenue).
justification.factor2Desc: Effectiveness of internal control environment and prior year ICOFR findings.
justification.factor3Desc: Magnitude and frequency of historical audit adjustments by external auditors/KAP.
justification.factor4Title: 4. Business & Accounting IT System Stability (Residual Risk)
justification.factor4Desc: Operational stability, business process re-engineering, or major ERP system migrations.

options.profit_oriented: Profit-Oriented (Stakeholder focus is on profitability / PBT)
options.asset_intensive: Asset-Intensive / Utility (Focus is on capital stewardship and fixed asset utilization)
options.revenue_driven: Revenue/Volume-Driven (Thin margins, focus is on revenue scale and growth)
options.volatile_breakeven: Volatile / Break-even (Earnings volatility is high; asset/revenue base used)
options.effective_strong: Strong / Effective (Mature control environment, no material weaknesses)
options.moderate_control: Moderate (Some control deficiencies noted and undergoing remediation)
options.deficient_material_weakness: Significant Deficiency / Material Weakness (Unresolved repeat findings)
options.low_clean: Low / Clean (Prior year audit adjustments were minimal or none)
options.moderate_adjustment: Moderate (Several audit adjustment entries recorded in prior year)
options.significant_adjustment: High (Significant audit adjustments were required in prior year statements)
options.stable_system: Stable (No significant changes in core business processes or ERP systems)
options.major_change_erp_restructure: Major Transformation (New ERP rollout, core migration, or restructuring)

justification.narrativeHint: This narrative is dynamically generated for audit workpapers and the Management Assessment Report.
